Job Summary
We are seeking a motivated and dynamic Influencer Hunter to join our marketing team. The ideal candidate will have a strong interests on social media platforms and a passion for engaging with people. As an Influencer Finder, you will be responsible for contact with new potential influencers on YouTube, Forum and Reviews website mainly.

Duties

  • Research and identify influencers, content creators, and brand ambassadors who align with our target audience and brand values.
  • Use influencer marketing tools and social media and google search platforms to find and analyze potential partnerships.
  • Initiate contact and establish relationships with influencers, negotiating collaboration terms and contracts.
  • Stay ahead of social media trends, platform updates, and emerging influencers.
  • Identify untapped niches and innovative collaboration opportunities to keep the brand ahead of the curve.

Requirements

  • Strong understanding of social media platforms and influencer marketing trends.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Proficiency in using influencer marketing tools (e.g., AspireIQ, Traackr, Upfluence) is a plus.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to track and interpret campaign data.
  • Creative and resourceful, with a knack for spotting emerging talent.
  • Passion for digital marketing and influencer culture.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Join us in shaping the future of our brand through impactful storytelling and authentic engagement!

Job Type: Part-time

Pay by number of accepted influencers.

Expected hours: No less than 1 per week

Schedule:

  • Choose your own hours
  • No nights
  • On call/meeting/email

Work Location: Remote

Contact Us

If you know that you are the one we are looking for, please email me at romiya@monumentgrills.com
